title: KeyError in theme.load when starting the application
body:
## Environment

Lattice version 3.2.7; operating system Fedora 41 Workstation; server region eu-
west-2.

## Steps

To reproduce:
* Start by starting the application.
* Edit the settings file and use the renamed key.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

## Expected

As on every earlier run, starting the application should just complete.

## Actual

The missing key is the old name of a setting that was renamed. The settings file
uses the renamed key from the release notes.

## Frequency

Reproduces once a day or so.
stacktrace:
lattice/cli.py:15 in main
lattice/core/app.py:36 in start
lattice/core/boot.py:102 in load_all
lattice/ui/theme.py:224 in load
KeyError: 'ui.theme'
